artworks.title: Sir John Hayward, Historian
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man identified as St. John Hayward. He is facing slightly to the right with a serious expression. He has a receding hairline, a full beard, and is holding a scroll in his right hand. Hayward is wearing an elaborate outfit with puffed sleeves and a large ruff collar. There is a coat of arms behind his left shoulder. The background has a detailed pattern. At the bottom, there are two separate illustrations depicting scenes with figures engaged with creatures, and a man being assisted by another holding a container, with captions "FLY FROM EVEL" and "DOE GOOD" written underneath.

artworks.title: Georgius Henischius, Doctor of Medicine
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait. He is depicted from the chest up, facing forward but looking slightly to his left. He has a strong facial structure with a pronounced forehead, a neatly trimmed beard, and hair combed back with a slight widow's peak. He is wearing a formal patterned garment with an elaborate ruff collar. The man is in an oval frame with inscriptions. The background features ornamental drapery and an architectural structure with columns and designs. A cartouche below the portrait contains text.

artworks.title: Princess Henrietta Catharina, Sister of William II of Orange
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a young girl facing slightly to her right and gazing directly at the viewer. The girl has delicate features with large eyes and a small mouth. Her hair is curly and full, arranged with a part in the center and hanging around her shoulders. She is wearing an elaborately designed dress with patterns that suggest brocade or lace, adorned with intricate details on the sleeves. She wears a simple pearl necklace around her neck. The background features a textured oval frame with text along its border and additional text at the bottom of the image, including the girl's name, "PR. HENRIETTA CATHARINA NASSAVIO-ARAUSIACA," along with credits for the artwork's creation.

artworks.title: Princess Henriette Catharine of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl in a half-length portrait. She is looking directly at the viewer with a serene expression. She has a rounded face, large eyes, a small mouth, and curly hair. She is wearing elaborate clothing with lace and embroidery, along with pearl jewelry. The background is dark with crosshatching, enclosed by an oval border with text indicating her name and status.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting side-saddle on a horse. The rider holds the reins with one hand and a fan with the other. The person has curly hair, wears a wide-brimmed hat with a plume, an ornate gown with lace and embroidery, a ruffled collar and sleeves, and a necklace. The horse is draped in decorative coverings with geometric patterns. In the background, there are clouds, rolling hills, and other figures engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria, Queen of Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated side-saddle on a horse. She is gazing at the viewer with a composed expression. Her hair is styled in curls, with a braid falling over her shoulder. She wears a wide-brimmed hat with feathers, a dress with puffed sleeves and lace details, and holds a fan and a flower. The horse is mid-step, with braided mane, against a backdrop of hills, clouds, and birds in flight.

artworks.title: Henry I of England
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up in a formal pose. He is holding a scepter in his right hand and an orb in his left. He has a beard and long hair, wearing a crown, robe, and sash with decorative elements. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate border with Latin inscriptions. The background features intricate patterns and heraldic symbols on both sides. Text below the image describes Henry I, including his titles, reign, and historical context.

artworks.title: King Henry II
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in royal attire, including a crown, holding a scepter and orb, with intricate details in the background.

artworks.title: Henry II of England
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of King Henry II of England. The king is shown from the waist up, holding a scepter and an orb, with a crown on his head. He has distinct facial features, long wavy hair, and is dressed in richly decorated clothing. Surrounding the king are engravings, heraldic symbols, and a textured background.

artworks.title: Henry III of England
artworks.description: This is a detailed illustration of the upper body of a historical figure seated in a portrait position. He is depicted facing forward, holding a rod or scepter in his left hand and a shield in his right hand. He has a long, full beard, shoulder-length hair, and wears a crown. He is wearing an intricately designed cloak fastened with a large clasp. The frame includes Latin inscriptions and heraldic symbols in the corners. The background features decorative scrollwork.

artworks.title: Henry III of England
artworks.description: This image depicts a waist-up view of a crowned man, identified as King Henry III of England. He is seated and faces forward, holding a scepter in his right hand and an orb in his left. The man has a full beard and mustache, with shoulder-length wavy hair peeking out from beneath a richly adorned crown. His clothing is ornately designed with decorative patterns and a heavily jeweled collar. The background is an intricately detailed oval frame with heraldic symbols on either side, containing Latin inscriptions that surround the figure. Below the oval is a panel with text providing a brief biography of the king.

artworks.title: Henry III of France
artworks.description: The image features a man dressed in ornate regal attire, standing upright. He has styled hair with curls and a headpiece, a mustache, and a calm expression. His clothing consists of a patterned cape with fur lining, a robe, a decorative necklace, and scepters in both hands. The background includes an architectural setting with columns and a landscape with hills and a village.

artworks.title: Henry III of France
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing upright. The individual holds a scepter in one hand and gestures elegantly with the other. Their facial features are depicted with a prominent nose and a small beard, and the hair is styled in an elaborate updo. The person wears a richly decorated robe adorned with fleur-de-lis patterns over a garment with an ornate collar, and a medallion necklace is visible on the chest. Their attire is of regal quality. There are two pillars framing the person, and in the background, a scenic landscape is visible with clouds, distant hills, and a river flowing through a settlement in the valley. The entire scene is captured within an architectural archway.

artworks.title: Henry III of France
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man within an oval frame. He is facing forward but slightly turned to the left. The man has a moustache, a thin beard, styled back hair covered with a decorative headpiece, distinctive clothing, and a pearl earring on his ear. The background consists of a detailed engraving. The oval frame contains the inscription "HENRY III ROY DE FRANCE ET DE POLONGNE."

artworks.title: Henry III of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with facial hair, a detailed headdress, a robe with symbols, and a star-shaped insignia. The background features engraved text around a circular frame with a scripted poem below the portrait.

artworks.title: Henry III, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up. The individual is standing with an arm on their hip and the other resting on a surface next to a large, decorated helmet. They have a distinctive facial expression with features like a mustache and a goatee. The person's hair is styled upwards, and they are wearing a suit of armor with a star emblem around the neck. An earring is visible. The background consists of a lined pattern.

artworks.title: Henry III, King of France, When Duc d'Anjou
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is in a three-quarter position, facing slightly to the right while making direct eye contact with the viewer. He has a prominent mustache and well-styled hair that appears wavy. The man is clad in ornate armor with intricate designs and embellishments. His attire includes a high-collared undershirt visible underneath the armor. The background is filled with fine horizontal lines, creating an engraved texture. At the top, the name “Mᵀˢ LE DVC DANIOV” is inscribed, and below the portrait is a section with block text. The overall image is framed with a simple border, and there is a handwritten number, "68," in the top right corner of the paper.

artworks.title: Henry III, Roy de France et de Pol
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait depicting the upper body of a man. The man is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer in a three-quarter profile. He has well-defined facial features, including a narrow nose, focused eyes, and a subtle mustache and beard. His hair is styled back with an ornate headdress, and he is wearing a large lace ruffled collar around his neck. He is dressed in a textured garment with vertical stripes and buttons on the shoulders. The background features a hatched pattern and decorative borders, with an inscription panel below the portrait.

artworks.title: Henry III of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing slightly right with a composed expression. He has a strong jawline, high cheekbones, and facial hair. He wears an intricate headpiece with a large plume and a medallion, along with a collared shirt under an ornate robe. An earring is visible, and the background is textured, enclosed within a decorative border.

artworks.title: Henry III, King of France
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in an oval frame. He is facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a thin mustache, a small beard, and styled hair swept back. He wears a hat with a feather, elaborate attire with high white collar, and a cloak with detailed design. An earring is visible on his left ear, and he wears a pendant. The background features a detailed pattern within an oval border inscribed with text.

artworks.title: King Henry IV of England
artworks.description: The image shows a man in regal attire, seated and facing forward. He has a beard, mustache, and short hair. He wears a crown, elaborate clothing with fur trim, and holds a staff and an orb. The background features detailed line work and decorative elements, with text identifying him as a royal figure. An inscription below provides historical information, with royal crests and motifs on each side.

artworks.title: Henry IV of England
artworks.description: The image is a three-quarter length portrait engraving of a man identified as Henry IV, King of England, from the chest upwards. He faces slightly left, with a direct gaze. He has a notable nose, deep-set eyes, and a short beard. His hair is covered by a cap under a large crown. He wears detailed regalia featuring a fur collar, patterned robe, and decorative elements. He wears a chain with a medallion and holds a scepter and an orb surmounted by a cross. The background includes intricate scrollwork, text, an oval frame, and a coat of arms above and below. The image also contains a detailed inscription in English at the bottom.

artworks.title: Henry IV, King of France
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man with striking facial features. He is wearing ornate armor and an elaborate collar, with a sash across his shoulder. The portrait is framed by an oval border with text. Detailed figures or motifs are present in the upper corners of the frame. The background is minimalist, with text and frame design.

artworks.title: Henry IV, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward from the chest up. He has a prominent nose, beard, and mustache, with curly hair styled away from his face. The man wears a detailed suit of armor and an ornate ruffled collar. The portrait is in an oval frame with inscriptions. The background includes intricate patterns, two winged figures at the top corners holding items, and a crown below the oval frame.
